## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/`, `fix/`, `docs/` or `chore/` and was created from an up-to-date `main`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] No `.env`, `node_modules/`, `venv/` or build output is committed
- [ ] New or changed code has comments explaining why
- [ ] I ran the app (backend and/or frontend) and followed "How to test" myself
- [ ] Docs (README) are updated if behaviour or setup changed
